verdict.rationale: AgentMail's docs say it supports standard IMAP and SMTP, so Outlook, Thunderbird, Apple Mail or any IMAP/SMTP client can connect to an inbox. That covers the open-protocol access part of the story. The pack has no evidence of JMAP or of a standards-based export format such as mbox or EML, so only about half the story is evidenced. missing for 10: JMAP access, documented standards-based export (mbox/EML), independent or hands-on corroboration of IMAP/SMTP access

support.subject: As a switcher, my mail stays reachable over open protocols and standard formats — IMAP/JMAP/SMTP access and standards-based export — so no client can lock me in

citations.quote: AgentMail supports standard IMAP and SMTP protocols, allowing you to connect using traditional email clients or integrate with existing systems that rely on these protocols.
Connect Outlook, Thunderbird, Apple Mail, or any IMAP/SMTP-compatible client to your AgentMail inbox
